purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The Bozhou bureau’s 2026-03-05 notice describes a public online inquiry interface that locates property by map click or keyword and returns basic nature/status information. It distinguishes complete registration records and downloadable cadastral diagrams for rights-holders after facial/e-ID verification. The official service list identifies the municipal registration center and frames legal public queries as application-based. No anonymous WUP-point full geometry was verified; no identity or property query was submitted.
registryAssessment: Official Bozhou bureau material names the municipal real-property registration center and describes local cadastral-map/registration services. Complete records and diagrams are explicitly identity-gated; basic public inquiry is distinct.
